title: Clear the pacman cache on Arch Linux
summary: Remove all downloaded package files from the cache to free up disk space. This deletes the .pkg.tar.zst files stored by pacman.

steps.explain: Empty the entire pacman cache. This removes all downloaded package files.

rollback.explain: The cache cannot be restored once deleted. You will need to re-download packages if you need to reinstall them.

warnings: Clearing the cache means you cannot reinstall a package without downloading it again.
